verdict.rationale: Bitbucket ships its own CI/CD engine, Bitbucket Pipelines, which runs automated workflows on hosted or private runners without needing infrastructure. It also documents AI-powered workflows triggered from the pipeline, such as fixing flaky tests and drafting release notes, which covers the core of headless, CI-driven automation. Missing for 10: documented CLI or API reference for scripting Bitbucket itself headlessly, pipeline configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
